aries_1.title: Aries 1
aries_1.summary: Raw initiative at the zodiac's opening degree, physical and impatient to be first.
aries_1.fullText: The traditional images are a thickset man in animal skins carrying a club, and a ball of fire riding above a rainbow. Together they set the tone of the first degree of the zodiac: force that has not yet been refined, and daring that outruns deliberation. Placements here confer real bodily courage, appetite for a contest, and the drive to arrive before anyone else. The cost is that force is reached for first and reasoned about afterwards, so the ego is easily engaged by trivial opposition.

aries_2.title: Aries 2
aries_2.summary: Sharp analytical intelligence carrying a warning against solving things by force.
aries_2.fullText: This degree is figured through the surgeon, the mathematician and the scientist — three occupations built on precision rather than power. It grants genuine analytical capability and the nerve to cut into a problem others will not touch. The traditional warning attached to it is self-destruction through brute force: the same decisiveness that makes a good surgeon becomes dangerous when applied where a scalpel is not what the situation needed.

aries_5.title: Aries 5
aries_5.summary: Security that rests on possessions and position rather than on anything solid.
aries_5.fullText: A knight stands on his castle wall defying the crowd below. The posture is confident and the confidence is misplaced — walls and armour are being counted as safety when they are only property. Placements here confer strong attachment to material standing and a defended, self-sufficient bearing. The degree's caution is that the defences are mistaken for the thing they protect, so a reversal in circumstances is experienced as a threat to the self rather than to the estate.

aries_7.title: Aries 7
aries_7.summary: A spiritual nature at odds with itself, ambition unsatisfied and confidence lacking.
aries_7.fullText: The imagery is deliberately earthbound — loggers, butchers, work done with the body on physical material — set against a genuinely spiritual disposition. That is the tension of the degree: something in the nature reaches upward while the life stays firmly in the material, and neither side is satisfied. Placements often carry real inner depth alongside a persistent shortfall of self-belief, so ambition is felt strongly and acted on hesitantly. Pride and spirit pull against each other rather than combining.

aries_8.title: Aries 8
aries_8.summary: Moral courage joined to fine manual or artistic skill, with a sharp tongue in reserve.
aries_8.fullText: Dancers, dentists and sculptors figure this degree — three kinds of work requiring exact control of the hands and an eye for form. Placements confer that precision along with a keen, quick mind and the moral nerve to say what others avoid. Left undeveloped the same sharpness turns to sarcasm and the same quickness to impulsiveness, and the degree carries an old warning about a vengeful streak. The faculty is fine either way; what varies is where it is pointed.

aries_9.title: Aries 9
aries_9.summary: Courageous energy in the service of a philosophy that wanders, and wants an audience.
aries_9.fullText: Soldiers and gunsmiths supply the martial charge of this degree, but the character it describes is a philosopher rather than a fighter — one who ranges widely, talks well and would like to be watched doing it. Placements confer conviction, physical courage and real rhetorical carry. The traditional counsel is self-forgetfulness: honour arrives here only when the craving for attention stops driving the argument. Notoriety is the failure mode, and it comes quickly when it comes.

aries_10.title: Aries 10
aries_10.summary: A magnetic goodwill that draws people in and lifts the life with them.
aries_10.fullText: This degree describes attraction rather than effort. Something in the disposition gathers friends and keeps them, and the ascent that follows is carried as much by other people's regard as by the native's own work. Placements confer warmth, an unforced likeability, and access to rooms that are otherwise closed. What the degree does not supply is the machinery of achievement — the rise depends on a quality that cannot be manufactured and can be squandered by trading on it too openly.

aries_11.title: Aries 11
aries_11.summary: Scientific capability paired with unusual sensitivity to grief.
aries_11.fullText: An uncommon combination sits in this degree: the disciplined mind capable of real advancement in a technical field, and a temperament acutely responsive to sorrow and bereavement. Neither is decorative — placements do serious work and feel other people's losses without being told about them. That pairing suits medicine, research into suffering, and any discipline where rigour and compassion have to operate at once. The strain of holding both is the degree's own difficulty.

aries_12.title: Aries 12
aries_12.summary: A self-willed eccentric who may clash with authority, or accept suffering and be refined by it.
aries_12.fullText: The labyrinth is the image, and it admits two readings that the tradition keeps side by side. In one, the native is markedly eccentric and self-directed, following an interior route that puts them across ruling powers. In the other, the same maze is a path of accepted suffering — a resignation that is not defeat and that leads somewhere genuinely elevated. Placements tend strongly to one reading or the other, and which one is not fixed at birth.

aries_13.title: Aries 13
aries_13.summary: Loyalty put to the test in obscurity, with the fog eventually lifting.
aries_13.fullText: An inverted triangle stands in dark fog that clears at length into bright blue and gold. The image is temporal: conditions are obscured now and will not stay so. What is being tested in the meantime is loyalty, and the specific temptation is ambition — an opening appears that requires abandoning a commitment. Placements that hold the commitment reach the blue and gold; the degree is unusually explicit that the reward follows the steadfastness rather than the cleverness.

aries_14.title: Aries 14
aries_14.summary: Leadership by going first toward a light, and the responsibility of being right about it.
aries_14.fullText: Someone sees a light and sets off toward it, expecting others to follow — and they do. That is genuine leadership and this degree confers it: conviction visible enough that people move on the strength of it. The whole weight of the image, though, rests on whether the light is true. A leader followed on faith who has misread the light does not fail alone, and the tradition attaches a warning about betrayal to precisely that possibility.

aries_16.title: Aries 16
aries_16.summary: Persuasion through rhythm and voice, anchored by a strong pull toward home.
aries_16.fullText: Musical rhythm and public oratory give this degree its character — the ability to move an audience by cadence as much as by argument. Placements confer a persuasive instrument and the confidence to use it in front of people. Underneath sits an unshowy attachment to family and household that acts as ballast, so the public gift does not become the whole of the life. The two halves steady each other; a placement here is rarely as extroverted as the platform suggests.

aries_17.title: Aries 17
aries_17.summary: A mind drawn to metaphysics, spiritualism and the occult.
aries_17.fullText: This degree turns toward what lies behind appearances. Placements carry a serious and usually lifelong involvement with metaphysical questions, spiritualist practice or occult study — not as decoration but as the axis the rest of the life organises around. The interest arrives early and does not lift. Its risk is the one common to all such study: an interior authority that answers to nothing outside itself and grows harder to check the longer it goes unexamined.

aries_18.title: Aries 18
aries_18.summary: Romantic feeling given poetic and literary form.
aries_18.fullText: Emotion here reaches for language. The degree is associated with novelists and with poets of a frankly feeling kind, and placements typically possess both the intensity and the craft to shape it into something readable. Romance is the recurring subject, treated seriously rather than lightly. The characteristic hazard is that a temperament this responsive can be governed by its own feeling-states, and the writing then records the weather rather than making anything of it.

aries_19.title: Aries 19
aries_19.summary: Concentrated creative force in a nature that is direct and sincere.
aries_19.fullText: Dynamic energy defines this degree, but it is energy with a spine — the character described is noble in bearing and plainly sincere, without the theatricality of the more showy Aries degrees. Placements confer the ability to gather themselves onto one object and stay there, which is what turns force into work. Concentration of this order is uncommon in a cardinal fire sign, and it is the whole of the degree's gift.

aries_20.title: Aries 20
aries_20.summary: A cautious, intelligent adventurer, equipped before setting out.
aries_20.fullText: An armed man in uniform stands ready for a difficult journey. Everything in the image is about preparation rather than bravado — he is armed, he is disciplined, and he has not left yet. Placements confer genuine appetite for pioneering work along with the good sense to provision for it, which is a rarer combination than either alone. This suits exploration, frontier projects and any undertaking where the risk is real and the return depends on having thought it through.

aries_21.title: Aries 21
aries_21.summary: A cooperative, expansive nature that will pay for its attachments.
aries_21.fullText: This degree describes someone conscious of themselves and generous with others, whose success comes through the people they gather rather than through solitary effort. Placements make friends easily and hold them. The cost is stated plainly in the tradition: personal sacrifices made out of a desire for attachment. Where the wish to be bound to others is strong enough, the sacrifices stop being chosen and start being extracted, and the expansiveness quietly narrows to whoever is asking.

aries_22.title: Aries 22
aries_22.summary: Active participation in amusement and display, without necessarily rising within it.
aries_22.fullText: A large ballroom or place of public amusement figures this degree. Placements take a real and active part in such settings — performance, entertainment, the social trades — and belong there without strain. The tradition is candid that participation is not the same as eminence: this is a degree of taking part rather than of becoming the reason others came. That is a limitation only if distinction was the point, and the degree suggests it usually was not.

aries_23.title: Aries 23
aries_23.summary: A conspicuous character whose influence works against those around them.
aries_23.fullText: A comet hangs pointed at the earth — a portent, and in the older reading not a welcome one. The degree describes notoriety rather than fame, and specifically an influence that proves harmful to others whether or not harm was intended. Placements carry unusual visibility and a capacity to affect people disproportionately. The warning is worth taking literally: the degree concerns effect rather than motive, and the effect is what is remembered.

aries_26.title: Aries 26
aries_26.summary: Inspired artistry expressed through travel and writing.
aries_26.fullText: Exploration, movement and literature run together in this degree, describing an artist of peaceable disposition whose material is gathered by going and looking. Placements confer genuine originality — the tradition uses the word genius, and means the inspired rather than the laborious kind — together with the restlessness that keeps supplying it with subjects. The peace-loving quality is real and distinguishes this from the more combative Aries degrees; the work gets made without a fight.

aries_27.title: Aries 27
aries_27.summary: Militant leadership and the preparedness to outlast opposition.
aries_27.fullText: Great soldiers and militant leaders give this degree its character: determination held over long periods and readiness maintained before it is needed. Placements confer the temperament for sustained campaigns rather than single engagements. Opposition is assumed rather than resented, and the tradition promises eventual success in spite of it — the emphasis falling on eventual. What the degree asks for is endurance, and what it offers in return is that endurance works.

aries_28.title: Aries 28
aries_28.summary: Exuberant generosity that attracts powerful protection, joined to real tenacity.
aries_28.fullText: A richly dressed woman stands with her arms open in welcome. The degree is warm and unguarded in its bearing, and that openness does practical work — placements draw influential friends and protectors who arrive because the generosity is genuine. Underneath the exuberance sits tenacity of purpose, which is what keeps the gifts from being merely social. The combination is unusually effective: the doors open through charm and stay open through persistence.

aries_29.title: Aries 29
aries_29.summary: Independent capability, useful to others, that clears its own obstacles.
aries_29.fullText: A strong man fells a tree with a book set down nearby — physical competence and intellectual life in the same frame, neither subordinate. Placements are self-directed and genuinely helpful, and the obstacles they meet are removed rather than negotiated around. The tradition attaches recognition to this degree in both directions, forestry and the life of the mind, which is really one observation: the same character does substantial work whichever material it is given.

aries_30.title: Aries 30
aries_30.summary: Talent and prosperity realising a high ideal, shadowed by the risk of sudden reversal.
aries_30.fullText: The closing degree of Aries brings musical gift and prosperity in partnership together under one idea: the power to bring a lofty conception down into an actual life. Placements can realise what they envision, which is not true of most of the sign. The warning attached is abrupt — sudden change, or treachery from a quarter that was trusted — and it applies specifically when the degree is afflicted. The ideal is reachable; what is not guaranteed is that it stays reached.

taurus_1.title: Taurus 1
taurus_1.summary: A clever, self-preserving nature that comes through conflict by strategy as much as strength.
taurus_1.fullText: A woman holding a sword, an athlete wrestling a bull, and a dark diamond: three images of force that is controlled rather than merely exerted. Placements meet real opposition and get through it by a mixture of diplomacy and staying power, protecting what is theirs without surrendering their own worth in the process. A strategic and somewhat poetic mind is described, able to perceive an order others have not reached yet, though often after a fragile start in early life. Inconsistency is what erodes the result.

taurus_2.title: Taurus 2
taurus_2.summary: Love and inner strength persisting in barren conditions, with isolation as the risk.
taurus_2.fullText: A crowned heart rests on bare rock. Nothing in the setting supports it and it endures anyway, which is the whole of the degree: generosity sustained from an internal source rather than fed by circumstances. Placements will make substantial sacrifices to reach a deeper understanding of things, and mean it. The tradition's warnings are isolation, inertia and ambitions inflated past any prospect of being met — all three being what happens when the internal source is the only source for too long.

taurus_3.title: Taurus 3
taurus_3.summary: Artistic sensitivity and sound judgement, with the harvest arriving late.
taurus_3.fullText: A mature woman gathers grapes. The fruit is real and it is being picked by someone who has waited — prosperity, success and romantic fulfilment tend to reach this degree in the second half of life rather than the first. Placements are deeply artistic and unusually receptive, often with a wandering, unattached quality in youth. What steadies the picture is the judgement: this degree evaluates situations well and is trusted by others to guide them.

taurus_4.title: Taurus 4
taurus_4.summary: Powerful, magnetic energy that becomes destructive without discipline.
taurus_4.fullText: A lion maddened by fire, and a circus arena. The pairing is exact — the same animal force that makes a life public and magnetic will, uncontained, turn into wrath, faction and trouble at home. Placements carry organisational command and a strict disciplinarian streak that is not incidental but necessary, since the discipline is what stands between the capability and the damage. Tact is described here as a learned skill rather than a native one, and it is the deciding factor.

taurus_5.title: Taurus 5
taurus_5.summary: Contentment found in physical work and the natural world.
taurus_5.fullText: A good-natured man splits wood in a fertile orchard. Everything in the frame is unhurried and productive, and the degree takes its character from that: wealth understood as sufficiency, patience as a settled disposition rather than an effort. Placements relieve other people's burdens without making an occasion of it and enjoy company and travel alike. Dexterity and the sense of touch are traditionally linked here, which suits the whole picture — this is a degree that knows things by handling them.

taurus_6.title: Taurus 6
taurus_6.summary: Sharp intellect and artistic passion, carried by persuasive speech.
taurus_6.fullText: A figure raised on a dais, and a three-headed form. The elevation is public and the multiplicity is real — this degree describes varied talent and the ability to win through negotiation rather than force. Placements combine scientific grasp with genuine artistic feeling and considerable passion in personal life, and are often called on to arbitrate. The traditional caution is that a nature this responsive either teaches its surroundings or is simply coloured by them, with little middle ground.

taurus_7.title: Taurus 7
taurus_7.summary: Sensuous appetite that can coarsen into vanity, or be redeemed through healing work.
taurus_7.fullText: A beautiful cow supplies the surface reading — comfort, self-regard, appetite pursued for its own sake — while darker images of torture and endurance sit alongside it in the tradition. The degree runs between those poles. Placements carry strong physical susceptibility and genuine romantic depth, and the same sensitivity that makes indulgence easy also supports real magnetic healing. Trials of the body or the feelings are common here and are the mechanism by which the degree resolves upward.

taurus_8.title: Taurus 8
taurus_8.summary: Obstacles and misjudgement, overcome by patient resourcefulness rather than cleverness.
taurus_8.fullText: An old man fishes branches out of a flooded river; a bare tree stands in a gale. Both images are of conditions that will not cooperate. Placements are prone to being taken in — losses here come through credulity and misread situations rather than bad luck — and the obstacles are described as formidable rather than trivial. What the degree does promise is that they are surmountable, and specifically through steadiness and resourcefulness applied over time.

taurus_9.title: Taurus 9
taurus_9.summary: A settled, trustworthy teacher, devoted to home and to the young.
taurus_9.fullText: A well-fed man feeds birds or cattle — an image of routine provision, given quietly and without display. The degree describes strong will housed in a peaceable temperament, devoted to household, children and the guidance of people younger than itself. Placements make natural teachers and careful investigators. Two shadows are noted: a tendency to sink into gloom when unoccupied, and a trustfulness broad enough that it is periodically exploited.

taurus_10.title: Taurus 10
taurus_10.summary: Material comfort and refined taste, with intuition running underneath.
taurus_10.fullText: An ox sleeps in the sun; a well-dressed woman studies her own reflection. Together they describe a degree oriented toward comfort and appearance, capable of real indulgence and of real trouble through it. But the second image carries more than vanity — refined taste here is genuine, and psychic or clairvoyant sensitivity is traditionally attached to this degree. Placements combine that intuition with a precise, almost mathematical mind and an obstinate streak in pursuit of what they want.

taurus_11.title: Taurus 11
taurus_11.summary: Shrewd worldly ambition or selfless service, the same force pointed opposite ways.
taurus_11.fullText: A crowned man seated among his wealth, and a monk ready to help whoever is nearest. The tradition sets these two directly against each other because the underlying capability is identical — a prudent, active nature that defends its principles and may face legal opposition for doing so. Placements reach high standing and risk being read as grasping, or spend the same drive on other people entirely. Expectations are frequently disappointed here, and imagination is strong enough to survive it.

taurus_12.title: Taurus 12
taurus_12.summary: A graceful, obliging nature that works hard and wants to please.
taurus_12.fullText: Butterflies settle on a bright flower, and a farm implement stands nearby — lightness and labour in the same degree. Placements are sympathetic, notably peaceable, and take real pleasure in pleasing other people, while underneath sits a sincere and unglamorous work ethic. The ambition is inventive, and the traditional caveat is about finishing: ideas arrive readily and are brought to completion slowly. Manual dexterity and an energetic charm are both native here.

taurus_13.title: Taurus 13
taurus_13.summary: Principles defended against the crowd, sometimes in court.
taurus_13.fullText: A frowning judge and a broken anchor. The first warns of prejudice met head-on, of legal contests and of the difficulty of holding a position the majority dislikes; the second of severe trials and an obscure ending. Set against them is a genuinely prudent character with aptitude for business or for healing, and — unusually for a degree this combative — a real willingness to grant that other views have something in them.

taurus_14.title: Taurus 14
taurus_14.summary: Hidden knowledge, held peaceably, with unusual power to persuade.
taurus_14.fullText: A reserved figure keeps watch over a dark cavern or a shuttered shop, guarding something not on display. Placements carry occult knowledge or simply undisclosed depth, and hold it without advertising. The disposition is strongly toward peace: this degree mediates other people's quarrels rather than starting its own, and magnetic healing is traditionally attached to it. The persuasive power is real and works through speech — quiet influence rather than oratory.

taurus_15.title: Taurus 15
taurus_15.summary: A sincere search for divine mysteries, endangered by appetite.
taurus_15.fullText: A student seeks light at the mouth of a cavern; a clear well stands in barren country. Both images are of something pure found in unpromising surroundings, and they describe a genuinely good character with implicit faith and broad religious sympathy. Running against that is a strong pull toward luxury and pleasure that can consume the means to pursue anything else. The tradition also allows a harsher figure here — a cold-tempered prophet — and warns of ruin arriving through what is untamed.

taurus_16.title: Taurus 16
taurus_16.summary: Early advantage and good company, undone by assuming it will hold.
taurus_16.fullText: Cattle graze without noticing the tiger. The degree grants a genuinely convivial spirit, a taste for good things and the favour of influential people — advantages that arrive early and easily. That is precisely the danger: prosperity taken as settled invites the reversal, and enemies here are unannounced rather than declared. The shrewd, hardworking version of this degree operates under pressure and would do better to be less guarded than it is.

taurus_17.title: Taurus 17
taurus_17.summary: A restless independent working permanently against the current.
taurus_17.fullText: A swimmer heads upstream; a gull wanders the coast. Placements here are constitutionally unsuited to settled routine and pay for it in unpopularity and hard going. The struggle is against entrenched habit rather than against people, which is why it does not resolve. Real musical or artistic ability accompanies the temperament, and sudden falls are traditionally attached to this degree — the originality is not in question, only whether conditions will ever be arranged to let it pay.

taurus_18.title: Taurus 18
taurus_18.summary: A combative disposition that will fight over very little.
taurus_18.fullText: Bulls in full collision, knights charging. Conflict attaches to this degree more consistently than to any other in the sign, and the tradition is blunt about it: a petulant, warlike temper roused by trivial provocation and requiring deliberate restraint. Placements make formidable opponents and need arguments to win. What complicates the picture is that genuine artistic talent, driven by real sympathy, sits in the same degree — the intensity is not only destructive.

taurus_19.title: Taurus 19
taurus_19.summary: An idle dreamer or an overreaching genius, depending on where the energy goes.
taurus_19.fullText: A woman lies at ease in a flowering field; an archer shoots at the moon. One image is of opportunity missed through inertia, the other of ambition aimed so far past the possible that it costs the archer standing. The tradition holds both against the same degree, and adds a third possibility — that this marks real genius rising from unpromising beginnings to considerable renown. Which of the three obtains is not settled by the placement.

taurus_20.title: Taurus 20
taurus_20.summary: Self-made originality that climbs, shadowed by a scheming counterpart.
taurus_20.fullText: Flags planted on summits and eagles at height give the degree its ambition: self-reliant, inventive, and capable of surmounting genuine difficulty to earn both success and respect. Placements make their own position rather than inheriting it. The counter-image is a crow — craft turned to envy, and gossip circulated maliciously enough that it eventually returns to its source. The same ingenuity serves either the climb or the scheme.

taurus_21.title: Taurus 21
taurus_21.summary: Watchful, methodical judgement with a public and sporting side.
taurus_21.fullText: An owl watches a snake. Nothing moves quickly in the image and nothing is missed — placements are silent, methodical and clear-sighted, with a working assumption that some opposition is concealed. The degree is also read as fortunate and open-handed, good at appraising what things are actually worth, and at home in sport and public regard. An analytical cast of mind suits it to chemistry, reasoning, medicine or speaking.

taurus_22.title: Taurus 22
taurus_22.summary: Diligence that produces light and healing for others, and prosperity for itself.
taurus_22.fullText: A grassy field with a tree and bees; a hand raising a torch; a pair of shears. Steady utility, guidance, and precise handwork — the three images agree that this degree earns what it gets. Placements are magnetic in a serviceable way, drawing people toward something useful rather than toward themselves. Artisan dexterity and surgical skill both sit here, and the prosperity that results is described as hard-earned and peaceable rather than sudden.

taurus_23.title: Taurus 23
taurus_23.summary: Great soul-force capable of conquering evil, and of falling through its own ambition.
taurus_23.fullText: A king pitches from his throne; Michael stands over the dragon; a smelting furnace burns. The degree holds enormous force and two opposite outcomes for it. Ambition that blinds brings the reversal, and it is described as complete rather than partial. The same power aimed outward conquers something genuinely worth conquering. The furnace is the reconciling image: a large-hearted, sensitive nature under heat, and what emerges depends on what was put in.

taurus_24.title: Taurus 24
taurus_24.summary: A patient worker who frees himself, warned against trusting the wrong people.
taurus_24.fullText: Crows pick at a dried riverbed; a prisoner strikes off his own fetters; the sun climbs over a dark hemisphere. The sequence runs from depletion through release to something larger — placements endure harassment patiently, extricate themselves, and are traditionally credited with a mission whose scope is not obvious early. The warning is specific and practical: credulity here leads to being drained and then unthanked. Medicine, humour and a fearless, dramatic bearing attach to this degree.

taurus_25.title: Taurus 25
taurus_25.summary: Formidable independent mind, either haughty or simply too far ahead to be recognised.
taurus_25.fullText: A lion rears and growls; a column of smoke stands lit by lightning; a dark pillar rises unexplained. The first is dominance justifying itself by force rather than merit. The second is native ability fighting up through difficulty toward recognition it has earned. The third is someone living unknown among people who never place him. Great mental strength and intuitive theory are constant across all three — what varies is whether anyone is ready for them.

taurus_26.title: Taurus 26
taurus_26.summary: Original, penetrating intelligence that either breaks orthodoxy or keeps the peace at home.
taurus_26.fullText: A giant tears up the statute books; a fair woman leads a child; an elephant stands still. The degree ranges from open contention against received authority to devoted domestic harmony, and the elephant reconciles them — deep sagacity, long memory, self-sufficiency, and no need to announce any of it. Placements show marked originality, aptitude for higher mathematics, and a persevering cast of mind that can bring incompatible parties into the same room.

taurus_27.title: Taurus 27
taurus_27.summary: Inventive, thrifty pioneering that must keep clear of the disreputable.
taurus_27.fullText: An alchemist works in his laboratory; an inventor stands admiring his engine; a dark cloud gathers into shapes. The first two describe ingenuity that pays — wealth arriving through unusual vocations, and genuinely valuable work produced by someone attentive to what is in the air before others notice it. The third is the warning, and the tradition puts it strongly: ruinous involvements and the darker arts. Patience, industry and a real attachment to the land ground the degree.

taurus_28.title: Taurus 28
taurus_28.summary: A mediumistic or scientific mind needing cultivation to keep it from vague ambition.
taurus_28.fullText: A man climbs a pole to no purpose; a woman looks into a crystal; a road runs straight. The first is aspiration without the competence to support it, and the tradition is unsparing about the conceit involved. The second is genuine receptivity that requires scientific or mathematical training if it is to yield anything but confusion. The third is the balanced outcome — an even mind and an uneventful, contented life. Literature and public regard attach here, and occasionally gambling.

taurus_29.title: Taurus 29
taurus_29.summary: A strong organising will at a crossroads, needing discipline against its own harshness.
taurus_29.fullText: A powerful man drives others with a whip; a traveller stands perplexed where roads divide; a crucifix stands by. The degree combines real organising capacity and stoicism with a genuine capacity for tyranny — dogmatic, self-serving, and certain. The crossroads is constant: placements are pulled by divergent forces and find decision difficult. Strange events and grievous accidents are traditionally attached, along with warnings about drink and other destructive outlets.

taurus_30.title: Taurus 30
taurus_30.summary: Forceful, philanthropic energy alongside a strong appetite for luxury.
taurus_30.fullText: A richly dressed man reclines on a couch; an ironstone rolls down a mountain; a lifeboat puts out into rough sea. Brilliance and generosity are native to this closing degree of Taurus, and so is a love of ease capable of ruining them. The rolling stone is power that must be aimed before it arrives somewhere on its own. The lifeboat is the degree at its best — active philanthropy that reaches people in real trouble. Clairvoyance, dramatic ability and work involving the eyes attach here.

gemini_1.title: Gemini 1
gemini_1.summary: Warm friendship and cultural enterprise, undercut by trusting too easily.
gemini_1.fullText: Yellow flowers under a tree give the benign reading — security, ease, and friendships that genuinely advance the life. Against it the tradition sets a blank white oval on black, which is as bleak an image as the sign offers. Placements are cultured, quick and markedly double-natured, capable of directing thought toward construction or damage with equal facility, and drawn to precise work in photography, writing or architecture. The recurring failure is unguarded trust, which the degree connects specifically to betrayal and to unhappiness in marriage.

gemini_2.title: Gemini 2
gemini_2.summary: Daring intellect that climbs at obstacles rather than around them.
gemini_2.fullText: A man scales a wall or mountain face carrying an axe. The tool is for cutting through rather than for fighting, and that is the character of the degree: obstacles are met directly and taken apart. Placements combine physical nerve with a real capacity for sustained study, and the same discrimination that makes a competent officer also makes an original researcher — chemistry and the sciences are traditionally attached. The stated flaw is reach: more begun than can be completed, more gained than can be held.

gemini_3.title: Gemini 3
gemini_3.summary: High idealism and eloquence in the service of art, with money left unattended.
gemini_3.fullText: Orpheus at the lyre, a troubadour listening to a waterfall, and a great Corinthian pillar. The first two are about beauty received and transmitted; the third is about scale — a nature strong enough to found something substantial. Placements are genuinely eloquent, deeply drawn to music and form, and capable of lifting an audience. The daydreaming is real and so is its cost, which the tradition locates precisely in personal finances. Resourcefulness and a wish to execute fine ideas exactly are both native here.

gemini_4.title: Gemini 4
gemini_4.summary: Exact observation joined to serious inward life.
gemini_4.fullText: A profile shows a single eye. Everything is turned toward looking, and looking narrowly — placements observe with a precision that suits detection and investigation of every kind. Set beside it is a venerable, kindly figure who rises to positions of trust on plain merit. The degree combines those: acute outward perception and a conscientious, self-denying interior that hungers for spiritual understanding and finds the material world oppressive. Generosity, intuition and real aptitude for magnetic healing follow from the same sensitivity.

gemini_5.title: Gemini 5
gemini_5.summary: Versatile capability staking itself on hazard.
gemini_5.fullText: Duellists, and a crossbowman taking aim. Both are images of a chance accepted deliberately, and the degree describes an ambitious, adventurous nature willing to risk its material position for a gain. Alongside sits a gentler figure — literary, romantic, working against reversed hopes and short of means until later life. The reconciling description is the all-rounder: neat, orderly, efficient in reasoning and slightly self-interested. Versatility and manual dexterity are genuine here, and so are the sudden contradictions of fortune.

gemini_6.title: Gemini 6
gemini_6.summary: Precise, impassive reasoning with a taste for research.
gemini_6.fullText: A woman holds a book and a set of scales, or a plumb line; nearby an analytical chemist works alone. Learning, sound judgement and a deliberately unemotional cast of mind define the degree — the juridical temperament, righteous and detached, which is an asset in law and a difficulty in intimacy. Placements are cautious, experimental and progressive, fond of domestic quiet and of animals. The counter-current is a rebellious streak that sets itself against the standing order and can attract sudden violent trouble.

gemini_7.title: Gemini 7
gemini_7.summary: Deep serenity that settles the people around it.
gemini_7.fullText: A swan on still water; a white ship under moonlight; and, oddly, a complete blank — the tradition treats this degree as holding a mystery it declines to explain. What is agreed is the peace. Placements are generous, contemplative and stable, and exert a genuinely calming influence without appearing to work at it, which is what makes them effective peacemakers. The degree also governs books, grammar and composition, giving an unusually smooth flow of language.

gemini_8.title: Gemini 8
gemini_8.summary: Driving commercial ambition with a short fuse attached.
gemini_8.fullText: A man writes in a ledger at a large desk; a house burns. The two images sit together deliberately. Placements are ambitious, critical and proud, ascending to executive position through an accurate grasp of what makes people weak, and are genuinely suited to commerce. The fire is the temper — impatient, easily affronted, apt to start disputes and to carry them home. The tradition calls this degree dualistic and self-contradictory, and the contradiction is exactly between the ledger and the blaze.

gemini_9.title: Gemini 9
gemini_9.summary: Commanding intelligence suited to authority and to hard problems.
gemini_9.fullText: A queen holds a globe and sceptre; a hand grips a royal seal; a labyrinth is laid out against the sky. Placements carry natural authority and are fit for governing, diplomacy or the magistracy, and tend to attract the favour of people in office. The labyrinth is the more interesting half — a mind that is genuinely equipped for tangled and enigmatic problems and enjoys them. Honesty and sincerity are noted, along with a nervous, critical temperament that makes the native hard company.

gemini_10.title: Gemini 10
gemini_10.summary: Charitable devotion to the suffering, backed by considerable force.
gemini_10.fullText: A nurse at a bedside, the Good Samaritan lifting the injured — and then, jarringly, a plant growing at monstrous speed. The first two describe a sweet, idealistic nature that sets its own wants aside to relieve other people, and means it. The third is the energy underneath: fortune here expands almost unaccountably fast. A colder reading also attaches to the degree, of someone who watches their interests closely, gains through partnership, and harbours something darker.

gemini_11.title: Gemini 11
gemini_11.summary: Shrewd speculation, and the discipline required not to gamble.
gemini_11.fullText: Vagrants on the road; a stock exchange in full noise. Wandering and wagering are the two poles, and the degree touches both — an alien, unsettled quality alongside a real appetite for financial hazard and the endurance to sit through it. A financier is described here, with an edge of deception. Placements are agreeable, highly versatile, and capable of demonstrating mind over matter. What the tradition presses is the use of intellect to avoid the hardship that follows trusting to luck.

gemini_12.title: Gemini 12
gemini_12.summary: Rigorous, mathematical scepticism that turns critical when unchecked.
gemini_12.fullText: An accountant frowns over a ledger; a crane stands against the sky; wolves work at a carcass. The first two are the degree at work — a mathematical mind that will not accept a claim before examining it, and a genuine fascination with mechanics and load. Placements are logical, high-strung and extremely critical, with sarcasm available at short notice and a deep distrustfulness underneath. The wolves are the warning: secretive acquisitiveness, and wealth assembled out of somebody else's collapse.

gemini_13.title: Gemini 13
gemini_13.summary: Restless ambition surrounded by people who cannot be relied on.
gemini_13.fullText: Card-sharps at their work, and a staircase that arrives nowhere. Both images concern effort that does not pay — the first through the treachery of others, the second through aspiration without fixed purpose. Placements are original, imaginative and markedly restless, with ambition that scatters and arguments that follow. The specific vulnerability is being imposed upon by unworthy friends, and the tradition's advice is unusually direct: discriminate carefully and make your own decisions rather than borrowing them.

gemini_14.title: Gemini 14
gemini_14.summary: Powerful abstract intellect, constant motion, and a warning about shortcuts.
gemini_14.fullText: A geometric cube — the most abstract image in the sign — indicates real philosophical reach and the capacity to mark the period one lives in. Set against it, a man carrying stolen jewels. The degree is strongly associated with travel and distance, with people who are permanently in motion, and with accidents caused by speed or inattention. The risk-taking is genuine and so is the entanglement it invites through other people's actions. Suffering is held to be avoidable only by taking a fixed position and holding it.

gemini_15.title: Gemini 15
gemini_15.summary: Quick, adaptable and scattered — imagination that needs training.
gemini_15.fullText: A wounded soldier; a fast inland stream; a woman who has not noticed the two-headed man beside her. Placements are ingenious and adaptable, following many callings, with an imagination prolific enough to make either an author or a practised liar of them. The stream is the temperament: turbulent, self-willed and shallower than it looks. The tradition is insistent that without deliberate mental training this fertility runs into useless channels and the ideas simply keep arriving.

gemini_16.title: Gemini 16
gemini_16.summary: Spiritual victory won by refusing force.
gemini_16.fullText: A shattered sword lies before a stone cross; elsewhere a man is roofing a building. The degree holds that faith and sacrifice outlast aggression, and describes someone who chooses non-resistance and becomes a demonstration of its worth rather than an argument for it. The roofer is the practical companion image — a lover of peace who builds something the community shelters under. Intuition is deep here, sometimes prophetic, and learning happens by absorption and curiosity rather than instruction.

gemini_17.title: Gemini 17
gemini_17.summary: Occult capability and a swift mind that must be aimed.
gemini_17.fullText: The breastplate of the high priest; a blind giant swinging an axe; a fox racing an arrow. The first is reverent, secretive study capable of real work. The second is the warning — power overestimated, energy spent on quarrels that mattered to nobody. The third is the mind itself: fast, shrewd, driven by high ideals and contending with a jumble of thoughts it must sort. A dreamy, impractical streak runs through the degree, along with teaching and an inherited house.

gemini_18.title: Gemini 18
gemini_18.summary: Bravery that gives itself away entirely to a cause.
gemini_18.fullText: A wounded eagle, whose blood raises a new brood. The bird is a target because it made itself one, and the power it draws on comes out of the injury rather than in spite of it. Placements lose themselves in a cause completely, and the resulting fearlessness disarms opposition rather than defeating it. The degree is energetic, enthusiastic and strongly dual, with a caustic intellect and vivid imagination. It is read as purely mercurial — built for communication and for trade.

gemini_19.title: Gemini 19
gemini_19.summary: Hardship met with devotion, and rescue arriving from outside.
gemini_19.fullText: A mountaineer caught in a storm is saved by the lightning that should have killed him. The degree describes danger, hard conditions and real surrender, resolved by something that can only be called intervention. Alongside it stands a humanitarian who gives up personal comfort to attend to others and finds ease only late. Emotion here is profound and ardent, and love is a frequent source of sorrow. The warning image is empty space — a character too open to whatever influence arrives.

gemini_20.title: Gemini 20
gemini_20.summary: Substantial achievement available if appetite is mastered.
gemini_20.fullText: A red tree hung with golden fruit; a drunken reveller holding a skull. The first is the degree at its height — effort that yields something of general benefit and carries the native to eminence. The second is the alternative, a fatalism that plays with life and shades toward cruelty where sensuality is not governed. The tradition frames this as transmutation rather than suppression: the same menace becomes philosophic power. Contemplative and hardworking, capable of violence, and of honours that end badly.

gemini_21.title: Gemini 21
gemini_21.summary: Quick, enterprising intellect drawn to the phenomena most people avoid.
gemini_21.fullText: An old man in a graveyard watches a spirit rise; elsewhere a woman feeds birds. The first is the degree's appetite — spiritual phenomena, occult philosophy, and experiments others would not attempt, with an interest in spiritism that matures into actual teaching. The second is its refinement: contemplative, generous, at ease in art and poetry. Placements are notably quick-witted, mathematical and enterprising, particularly early, and the two halves of the degree tend to arrive in that order.

gemini_22.title: Gemini 22
gemini_22.summary: A gentle, theoretical nature that attaches itself usefully to others.
gemini_22.fullText: Ivy spreads over stone. The plant is not parasitic exactly — it holds to what is solid and thrives — and the degree describes someone who recognises useful people and builds a position alongside them, saving carefully. Recognition tends to arrive through literature, and others attach themselves in turn. Placements are inventive, mathematically able and immovable about their own conclusions. A sunrise struggling against remaining night gives the arc: early difficulty resolving into clarity.

gemini_23.title: Gemini 23
gemini_23.summary: A life of two halves, carried by intuition and luck.
gemini_23.fullText: A triangular hill stands with one face in sun and one in shadow. The tradition reads the division temporally — fortune and refinement early, and a second half requiring considerable care. Luck and guessing are explicitly attached to this degree, along with uncanny mathematical facility and a leaning toward gambling or invention. Placements are shy and generous, apt to miss the advantages they were handed, and turn to mysticism to solve what arrives later. Cheerful and spontaneous in company, though not deep in it.

gemini_24.title: Gemini 24
gemini_24.summary: Charity of soul that arrives at genuine distinction.
gemini_24.fullText: A woman hands bread to the starving and a crown of light settles on her. The glory in the image is a consequence rather than a goal, which is the point of the degree — charity in thought and action, offered without calculation. Placements begin by subordinating themselves to a partner and widen into something universal. Considerable verbal talent and a well-grounded confidence in themselves and others attach here, along with the deer: fine sensibility, love of art, and a studious bent toward research.

gemini_25.title: Gemini 25
gemini_25.summary: Reserved, concentrated originality carrying a sense of mission.
gemini_25.fullText: A hand reaches from heaven holding a scroll marked with a pentagram; nearby, a balloon. The first describes real ethereal force and a destiny experienced as strict — an occultist whose work is to show others what life is for, and who must stay clear of the material gambles the sign is prone to. The balloon is the counter-warning: capable of striking, showy feats and of never once completing a grounded enterprise. Placements are studious, reserved and capable of intense concentration.

gemini_26.title: Gemini 26
gemini_26.summary: Quick thinking amid unsettled conditions and deceptive surfaces.
gemini_26.fullText: A broken trident falls into the sea; a couple weep at the shore; a mirrored room stands empty. The trident warns of allurement into genuinely unstable conditions where speculation proves fatal and appearances mislead. The weeping pair carry the emotional reading — melancholy, dependence, mismatched marriage or lasting mistrust. The mirrors are the third face: strict conformity, fashion, and self-regard. Placements think exceptionally fast, and the degree attaches dancers, jealousy and low spirits.

gemini_27.title: Gemini 27
gemini_27.summary: Refined diplomatic gift that must be willed into use.
gemini_27.fullText: A man looks gloomily at a violin whose strings have broken. The instrument is not beyond playing; the surrender to worry is the actual problem, and the tradition says plainly that the native must exercise will enough to draw music from a damaged instrument. Placements are diplomatic and somewhat self-absorbed, and the finer side emerges only when deliberately cultivated. Solemn, melancholic genius attaches here, and writers on astrology. A gilded star warns of decorative artifice preferred to substance.

gemini_28.title: Gemini 28
gemini_28.summary: Indefatigable industry and a deep attachment to what is old.
gemini_28.fullText: Workmen drive a railway across barren country; a baronial house stands nearby. The first is the degree's engine — prudent, tireless labour that overcomes real difficulty and leaves something others use afterwards. The second is its temper: a scholar of antiquity who dislikes change and distrusts new methods. Placements are fond of tradition, of old objects, and of their own locality. The organising insight is that self-mastery is the effective force, which sends the native to the wisdom of the ancients.

gemini_29.title: Gemini 29
gemini_29.summary: Original, magnetic capability with a despotic streak to guard.
gemini_29.fullText: A child blows a steel gauntlet off a stone cube. The simplicity is the power — placements carry a knowledge of unseen forces that turns aggression aside without effort, and an impulsive originality that succeeds precisely by not doing things the established way. The counter-images are ugly and the tradition means them: a man flogging a boy, a wolf working toward a sheep. Authority abused, and a cunning instinct for domination and betrayal, sit in the same degree as the seership.

gemini_30.title: Gemini 30
gemini_30.summary: Sharp observation and adaptability inside narrow limits.
gemini_30.fullText: A bound woman smiles at an angel; elsewhere an execution proceeds. The first is the degree's condition — scope of action severely constrained by circumstance, a life of unusual obstacles, strange feelings and stumbles, met with something like equanimity. The second is its warning, and it is about company: watch who you are associated with, or answer for what they did. Placements have real talent for emulation and for reading people, which turns to hypocrisy when afflicted, and hold that hard work answers most dangers.

cancer_1.title: Cancer 1
cancer_1.summary: Tender sympathy and public warmth at the sign's opening degree.
cancer_1.fullText: A well-fruited vine spreads over an old wall; a ring is set with a heart of white onyx; a weighted clock keeps time. The vine gives the degree its character — strong attachments, contentment, and a life that quietly produces. The onyx heart adds occult learning and a settled compassion, and the clock a shrewd eye for cause and effect. Placements are sensitive and largely unselfish, comfortable in public, and unusually effective in work that attends to what large numbers of people need.

cancer_2.title: Cancer 2
cancer_2.summary: Strong feeling paired with a reluctance to do the work.
cancer_2.fullText: A dog guards a bone from hungrier animals; a labourer leans on his tool while others dig; a man waters shrubs in a greenhouse. The first two carry the warning — self-interest, inertia, and a willingness to live off other people's effort, with important matters handed to whoever will take them because comfort matters more. The greenhouse redeems it: a real love of growing things and of beauty. Placements are pleasant and serious, and struggle with jealousy and emotional confusion when the feeling has nowhere to go.

cancer_3.title: Cancer 3
cancer_3.summary: Passion strong enough to override judgement, alongside genuine scholarship.
cancer_3.fullText: A grieving woman holds faded flowers, her hair undone; a creeping plant is being eaten at the root; a deep shaft opens, and a balloon rises. The first two are decay — passions that overrun reason, sorrow arriving through relationships, and losses inflicted quietly by whoever manages the native's affairs. The shaft and balloon are the other face entirely: a scientist at home both underground and in the air. Dignity, scholarship, optimism and considerable ambition sit in the same degree as the ruin.

cancer_4.title: Cancer 4
cancer_4.summary: Appetite for pleasure, and impulsive judgement about where to spend.
cancer_4.fullText: A table stands loaded with the remains of a feast; a miner reads a newspaper glumly on a goldfield. Both concern consumption — the first of pleasure, the second of a rumour that turned out to be worth nothing. Placements are sensual and extravagant, with a keen intellect that keeps satisfying itself on things that do not last, and a habit of acting on unverified reports. The disposition is serious and independent underneath, with sharp senses, and the tradition warns against violence and overconfidence.

cancer_5.title: Cancer 5
cancer_5.summary: Warmth and intuition undermined by misplaced confidence.
cancer_5.fullText: A sapling bent out of true by a storm; a man entertaining lavishly while a clown laughs behind him; a figure holding balanced scales. The sapling is the degree's vulnerability — a trustful nature that puts its confidence in the wrong hands and can be broken by its own passions. The clown is the specific mechanism: wastefulness that attracts false friends. The scales are the corrective, a just mind quick to detect a lie. Medical aptitude and an active interest in everyone are noted.

cancer_6.title: Cancer 6
cancer_6.summary: Worldly appetite and sharp, secretive commercial instinct.
cancer_6.fullText: A gaudily dressed woman plays with her jewels; a Corinthian column is crumbling from within; a tract of land is mapped out for a farm. The first is show without substance, though paired with an accurate understanding of people. The column is grandeur carrying a concealed flaw or fear. The farm is the degree working: a successful adventurer who plans ground properly. Money comes easily here and goes the same way. Pawnbrokers and misers attach to this degree, along with a secretive nature prone to trance.

cancer_7.title: Cancer 7
cancer_7.summary: Fearless will, capable of tyranny or of refined command.
cancer_7.fullText: An iron gauntlet, a sword and a scourge; a newspaper editor with his mouth stopped; one beautifully coloured apple. The first set is the warning — an aggressive nature convinced that might settles matters, and capable of real cruelty when crossed. The muzzled editor holds other people's secrets and may be bought. The apple is the promise: a rise to a position nobody else occupies. Placements are physically fearless, appreciate diplomacy, and are more emotionally exposed than they appear.

cancer_8.title: Cancer 8
cancer_8.summary: Public charisma with a strong pull toward what will damage it.
cancer_8.fullText: A snake gathers to strike at a dove; an acrobat works a crowd; a man rings a bell high in a tree. The snake is the degree's real hazard — susceptibility to worldly seduction and to attachments kept hidden, which is what fractures the domestic side of the life. The acrobat is resourceful and energetic and genuinely thrives on public risk. The bell-ringer is the vocation: publishing, broadcasting, carrying news. Placements are warm, hold other people's confidences, and reach eminence in speech.

cancer_9.title: Cancer 9
cancer_9.summary: Modest, patient work that quietly arrives at mastery.
cancer_9.fullText: A village sits in a fertile valley; a painter works in a forest glade at sunset; a spider watches its web. The village is the degree's temper — good-hearted, thrifty, unhurried, and successful because of it rather than despite it. The painter draws on nature directly and perseveres. The spider is the sharper faculty: the lawyer's or detective's patience. Placements often begin as iconoclasts and pass through several changes before the public warms to them, and frequently work several unconventional trades.

cancer_10.title: Cancer 10
cancer_10.summary: Maternal, magnetic force that shelters growth in others.
cancer_10.fullText: A broad oak shelters young shoots; girls dance in garlands of wildflower; a bulb pushes up through turf. The oak is the degree's function — reliable, industrious, providing cover, and reaching a well-regarded old age. The dancers are its brightness, a joy that actively resists what is sour. The bulb is the will underneath: quiet soul-force pushing through resistance. Placements are intuitive and home-centred, suited to teaching or mothering, and carry a settled inner knowledge that does not need arguing for.

cancer_11.title: Cancer 11
cancer_11.summary: Retentive intelligence shadowed by melancholy and by sudden weather.
cancer_11.fullText: A dagger lies beside a skull; a caduceus stands between waxing moons; trees bend in a gale. The first pairing gives the degree its range — real scientific or literary capability, and a pull toward gloom and severe swings of mood. The trees give the other difficulty: careful long-range planning undone by something nobody forecast. Placements are charming and magnetic and must actively work against isolation. The tradition attaches warnings about poisons and about entanglements entered through deceit.

cancer_12.title: Cancer 12
cancer_12.summary: Penetrating, versatile intellect with volatile material underneath.
cancer_12.fullText: A caduceus between two moons; a man carrying a lamb with a dagger concealed; a volcano in eruption. The first is the gift — a mind that goes deep and can master subtle sciences or languages. The second is the concealment, and the darker passions the degree struggles with. The volcano is temperament and appetite together: venturesome, fixed in its views, drawn to hazardous ideas the majority rejects. Placements are industrious and intensely detailed, with a quick temper that requires deliberate governing.

cancer_13.title: Cancer 13
cancer_13.summary: Iron will and wide competence, arriving at real prominence.
cancer_13.fullText: A star shines above flowers; a lamb wears a crown; a crab climbs an iron spear. The first two are the fortunate reading — a serious, determined nature that prospers through affinity with nature, science or astronomy. The crab on the spear is the method: undaunted ascent up something hostile and unsuited to climbing, which is why the native is thought stubborn. Placements are emotional, energetic, unusually versatile, and never short of a resource when one is required.

cancer_14.title: Cancer 14
cancer_14.summary: Ambition that prefers strategy to labour.
cancer_14.fullText: A dog, or a rat, asleep on a throne; an auctioneer's hammer coming down on gold. The throne is occupied by something that did not earn it — an indolent nature that dislikes work and reaches high position through manoeuvre and intrigue instead. The hammer is the same faculty applied commercially, sagacity and craft turned to securing material advantage. Placements are content with little and possess a singleness of purpose that hardens into severity when control is threatened. Forced work is the making of them.

cancer_15.title: Cancer 15
cancer_15.summary: Overwhelming strength of purpose, physical or spiritual.
cancer_15.fullText: Samson stands over the lion he has killed; a young man on a mountain takes hold of a sword out of the sky. The first is tenacity and force sufficient to destroy a genuine enemy. The second is the same power under mandate — an inspired figure carrying a mission he did not choose. The tradition also marks this a blank degree, a mystery it will not open. Placements are taciturn and capable, well suited to business or mathematics, with warnings about the eyes.

cancer_16.title: Cancer 16
cancer_16.summary: Restless pioneering energy that rewires whatever it touches.
cancer_16.fullText: Lightning flashes; merchants cross the sand on camels; artificial globes stand in a study. The lightning is nervous energy and executive drive — a reformer who clears away doubt and overturns settled belief. The caravan is the same restlessness made productive, a self-possessed traveller who introduces nations to one another through trade. The globes are the study behind it: humanity examined deliberately. Placements are hardworking and intensely active, and the ambition leaves a mark that outlasts them.

cancer_17.title: Cancer 17
cancer_17.summary: Luxury pursued past the means to support it.
cancer_17.fullText: Exotic flowers past their best; gamblers in a well-appointed room; a hand closing on gold that is already falling. Every image is of value in the act of escaping. Placements live beyond their means for the sake of appearances, are more fragile than they present, and place wealth above friendship — losing, in the end, precisely what was being hoarded. The disposition is wilful and defensive, and opportunities are genuinely fewer here, so the appetites need reining rather than indulging.

cancer_18.title: Cancer 18
cancer_18.summary: Tireless independent thought, and a dangerous energy to control.
cancer_18.fullText: A shield bears a harp and a gauntlet; an old man reads an illuminated book by poor light. The escutcheon is the mixture the degree runs on — noble aspiration, refined taste, gentleness and irritability in the same character. The reader is its dedication: a profound, unwearying thinker giving a life to abstruse questions in deliberate isolation. The tradition attaches a powerful and potentially destructive energy here, connected with chemicals or poisons, and insists the native guard both their independence and their temper.

cancer_19.title: Cancer 19
cancer_19.summary: Capable service, either in obscurity or in erratic adventure.
cancer_19.fullText: A liveried groom rides a spirited horse; a wounded Bedouin crosses the desert. The groom is devoted, quick-perceiving and honest, and his usefulness is real even though his name is not known. The Bedouin is the same competence unhoused — freedom-loving, resistant to restraint, travelling for the experience of it. Placements are firm and politically inclined and can do work that lasts. The warning is specific: disgrace arriving suddenly, and arriving after the fame rather than instead of it.

cancer_20.title: Cancer 20
cancer_20.summary: Brilliance spread across too many undertakings at once.
cancer_20.fullText: A waning moon hangs over a disabled ship. Both halves are losing way. The degree describes a fickle, unsettled character who begins more than can be sustained and risks the foundation through simple lack of persistence, with moderation prescribed almost as a remedy. Against that sits a commanding mind that naturally expects to direct rather than be directed, and which consequently finds itself at odds with whoever currently holds authority. Real ability as an independent worker or writer is noted.

cancer_21.title: Cancer 21
cancer_21.summary: Executive power exposed to sudden reversal.
cancer_21.fullText: A king rides at the head of his people; behind him the waning moon and the crippled ship reappear. The degree holds command and instability in one frame — genuine authority and aptitude across many things, limited by circumstance and frequently at variance with those in power. Placements act on impulse, which is what converts the limitation into a reversal. The tradition is even-handed: the power is not illusory and neither is the fall, and which arrives first is not fixed.

cancer_22.title: Cancer 22
cancer_22.summary: Sensitivity and indolence, with a fall available from a height.
cancer_22.fullText: A man sleeps through the heat of the day; a jewelled crown drops into mud. The sleeper's misfortune comes from simple want of energy rather than from any enemy. The crown is the sharper warning — standing lost through bad influence rather than bad luck. Placements are proud and drawn to what glitters, and the degree is candid about the superficiality. Set against it, real healing ability and a poetic idealism that tends to emerge from unpromising beginnings.

cancer_23.title: Cancer 23
cancer_23.summary: Obstacles surmounted, arriving at elevation and calm.
cancer_23.fullText: A man stands on a summit at sunset; fishermen draw nets in still weather; a burly man works in an apron. The summit is earned rather than granted — the degree is explicit that the elevation follows the obstacles. The fishermen supply its temper afterwards, peaceable and receptive. The apron places the work: catering, provisioning, public service of a practical kind. Placements succeed through patience and appetite for adventure in roughly equal measure, and healing attaches here too.

cancer_24.title: Cancer 24
cancer_24.summary: Masterful endurance and charm, with a narrow streak to watch.
cancer_24.fullText: A castle stands on high rock beneath a crowned flag; a dancer moves gracefully; a small church is ornamented past its size. The castle is the degree's spine — ambition, mastery and considerable staying power. The dancer is its expression, and artistic work genuinely succeeds here. The over-decorated church is the warning: strictness hardening into bigotry. Placements include the seer and the critical writer, and carry the particular audacity required to be different on purpose.

cancer_25.title: Cancer 25
cancer_25.summary: Independent aspiration whose influence carries well beyond its ground.
cancer_25.fullText: A tall pine stands alone; an armed horseman crosses desert; the setting sun lies reflected on the sea. The pine is the degree's reach — a good influence felt considerably further than the native's own neighbourhood. The horseman is self-reliance, pioneering by disposition rather than necessity. The reflected sun is the receptive faculty: a strongly psychic nature that takes up the thoughts around it. Independence and literary talent together let original ideas leave something behind.

cancer_26.title: Cancer 26
cancer_26.summary: Perseverance and brilliance, punctuated by sudden reversal.
cancer_26.fullText: A marksman misses eight times and hits the ninth; a meteor falls; a gentleman rides out in a carriage with ladies. The marksman is the degree's virtue, undaunted repetition until the shot lands. The meteor is its liability — aesthetic, eccentric, brilliant briefly and subject to abrupt reversal. The carriage warns of incaution in company. Placements are scientific or mystical by bent, generous, and tend to experience the rise and the misfortune in that order.

cancer_27.title: Cancer 27
cancer_27.summary: Peaceable goodness, at risk of being dazzled.
cancer_27.fullText: A pear tree stands heavy with fruit; a well-kept heifer draws the plough; a moth circles a flame. The tree is the degree at its best, abounding in goodness and functioning almost as a charm for peace around it. The heifer is its docility — real success, achieved under guidance rather than independently. The moth is the danger: a yielding will hypnotised by glitter. Agriculture and patient work alongside natural processes attach to this degree.

cancer_28.title: Cancer 28
cancer_28.summary: Harmony and love of the countryside, shading toward thrift.
cancer_28.fullText: A quiet country scene, an old mill-wheel beside a lily pond; elsewhere, heaps of gold and silver. The first is the degree's promise — a harmonious life and a fortunate marriage, both unforced. The coins are its narrowing: caution turning by degrees into miserliness. Placements are determined and careful, and succeed both in agricultural work and in original artistic effort. The two images are not opposed so much as sequential, and which one dominates is a matter of appetite.

cancer_29.title: Cancer 29
cancer_29.summary: Severe restriction, with release found inwardly.
cancer_29.fullText: A prisoner sits in his cell while a bird sings at the window; a tethered horse watches a tiger approach; a man drives a bull. The cell is the degree's condition — physical limitation answered by an inward freedom that is genuine rather than consoling. The tethered horse is the sharper version: a subtle mind held under restraint it did not choose, with danger nearing. The bull gives the practical outlet, success in earthy trades. Placements act on sudden impulse to break their bounds.

cancer_30.title: Cancer 30
cancer_30.summary: Untamed independence and a strong sense of destiny.
cancer_30.fullText: A young horse runs loose across open field; a winged wheel crosses green country; an acute triangle is marked with a cross. The horse is the degree's temper — wilful, and attached to freedom past the point of convenience. The winged wheel is force joined to skill, motion that is going somewhere. The triangle and cross give the bearing: commanding, and settled in its own will. Clairvoyance attaches here, along with a real interest in growing things, closing the sign where it began.

leo_1.title: Leo 1
leo_1.summary: Magnetic leadership at the sign's opening, undercut by changeable direction.
leo_1.fullText: A lion stands on high ground facing the sunrise; behind it, banners stream in opposing directions. The lion is the degree's dignity — natural authority, nobility of bearing, and leadership assumed rather than sought. The banners are its instability, a whimsical streak that reverses course for no visible reason. Placements are forceful and magnetic, and appear to know things without having learned them. The pioneering appetite is genuine and relies on quick intelligence rather than preparation to carry it through.

leo_2.title: Leo 2
leo_2.summary: Social grace over an uncertain centre.
leo_2.fullText: A man sits dejected before a light that has been obscured; a pennant shifts with the wind. The covered light is the degree's difficulty — an ordeal that requires real faith to pass through, and a susceptibility to going wrong if it is not found. The pennant is the temperament: changeable, and inclined to adopt other people's ideas for want of confidence in its own. Placements possess genuine social charm and considerable artistic feeling, and are more absorbed in themselves than the charm suggests.

leo_3.title: Leo 3
leo_3.summary: Patient observation and strategy, arriving at leadership.
leo_3.fullText: A cat sits motionless by a pond, watching. Everything is in the waiting — placements are shrewd, unusually observant, and capable of holding still far longer than the situation seems to require, which is what makes their eventual move effective. The mind is quick to take hold of complicated material and has a gift for making ordinary things interesting. Enthusiasm and literary facility attach here, along with a reputation for occult or spiritual capability that others come seeking. Compassion is the thing that can be missing.

leo_4.title: Leo 4
leo_4.summary: Caution and strong feeling, with real danger from concealment.
leo_4.fullText: A snake lies coiled around a tree, gathered to strike. The degree runs on wariness — competition that will use dishonesty if it must, met by a circumspect and active nature that wants matters straight and is genuinely wounded by discord. Placements carry a powerful will and a strong capacity for love, and the traditional advice is silence: what is disclosed here tends to be used. Dignity and self-protection are constant, and religion or the arts is where the temperament usually settles.

leo_5.title: Leo 5
leo_5.summary: Solitary investigation, trusting its own reasoning above advice.
leo_5.fullText: This degree describes a searcher rather than a symbol — a strong character content with a retired life given over to patient, intelligent enquiry. The instruction attached to it is unusually specific: use your own reasoning rather than resting on advisers, because the improvement here is self-made or it does not happen. Placements are self-reliant perfectionists who want the good things and set about refining their own capabilities to deserve them, which is slower than borrowing an opinion and holds better.

leo_6.title: Leo 6
leo_6.summary: Courage and command, with energy that has to be governed.
leo_6.fullText: A man rides a lion, carrying a sceptre set with a diamond. Both animal and gemstone are being mastered rather than merely owned, which is the degree exactly: courage and nobility directed toward outstanding success and, the tradition suggests, a name that outlasts the life. Martial capability and athletic strength are native. So is the warning — energy at this level ruins the native if it is not controlled. Business enterprise and sheer ingenuity carry placements past troubles other people caused.

leo_7.title: Leo 7
leo_7.summary: Intuitive spiritual authority that others willingly acknowledge.
leo_7.fullText: A sceptre burns like a star; an eye sits within a triangle of flame. The first marks someone born toward power, eminence and public regard, the second an intuitive nature genuinely occupied with philosophy rather than decorated by it. Placements are courteous and generous, mix easily, and are held in high esteem by the people they work among — which the degree treats as earned rather than lucky. The intuition is strong and functions as the real instrument here.

leo_8.title: Leo 8
leo_8.summary: Spiritual ardour and material vanity in the same character.
leo_8.fullText: An aureole of cloud opens on a flaming triangle; elsewhere a peacock struts behind a nobleman. The first is the degree exalted — noble ambition genuinely fired by something above itself. The second is its shadow, and the tradition is unkind about it: conceit, ostentation, and worth measured by display. Placements are affectionate and passionate idealists who reach eminence and know how to protect themselves once there. A restless appetite for variety runs underneath both readings.

leo_9.title: Leo 9
leo_9.summary: Generous sociability learning, slowly, where worth actually sits.
leo_9.fullText: This degree describes a talkative, positive nature fond of travel and of business, and frequently misunderstood — the tradition's explanation being that the native does not entirely understand themselves either. Tastes are refined and initially attached to appearances, and it takes experience rather than argument to move the valuation inward. Placements combine genuinely acute commercial instincts with an extravagance that enjoys spectacle, and the two coexist for a long while before the first disciplines the second.

leo_10.title: Leo 10
leo_10.summary: Fearless advocacy for justice, and the enmity that follows it.
leo_10.fullText: This is a degree of contention on principle. Placements take strong public positions on questions of justice and make enemies by it, which the tradition treats as a cost rather than a mistake. The character is versatile and firm, occasionally morose, and seriously interested in the mysteries of life and death. Against that sits a sociable, capable administrator who dislikes unpleasantness and uses confidence and diplomacy to get through it — the same person, in a better mood.

leo_11.title: Leo 11
leo_11.summary: Sociable, outspoken artistry, at risk from its own appetites.
leo_11.fullText: A white bull grazes beside a woman reading; elsewhere a laden table, and a woman lifting her skirts. The bull and the book give the degree its calm, benevolent surface. The other two give the appetite underneath — pleasure sought for itself, and indulgence that does not stop where it should. Placements hold broad views and say them plainly, are devoted as friends once jealousy is mastered, and possess a refined temperament that is frequently let down by an absence of planning.

leo_12.title: Leo 12
leo_12.summary: Fortune that attends whatever the native undertakes.
leo_12.fullText: A decorated ship rides a calm sea. The degree is straightforwardly fortunate — the tradition says what the native does will prosper, which is a stronger claim than it makes almost anywhere else. Placements are sensitive and rather shy, deeply fair-minded, and socially graceful in a way that draws good things toward them. The impressionability is real, but so is an earnestness about setting wrongs right. Artistic work and vocations centred on people are where this degree does best.

leo_13.title: Leo 13
leo_13.summary: Trained hand and eye producing excellence, if it will cooperate.
leo_13.fullText: This is the artisan's degree: a disciplined eye, a trained hand, and an idealism that raises the result above competence. Placements are fortunate and impetuous, patriotic in temper, and tend to improve whatever company they join. A penetrating, magnetic intensity makes them formidable investigators. The condition attached is cooperation — the same intensity turns overbearing when it forgets there are other people in the workshop, and the excellence is a joint product more often than the native admits.

leo_14.title: Leo 14
leo_14.summary: Brilliant risk-taking, or mystical study, from the same ingenuity.
leo_14.fullText: Men toss coins. Gaming gives the degree its surface — a brilliant, impulsive character who takes chances and attracts public notice for it. Set against that, and drawing on the same faculty, is a deeply idealistic nature occupied with occultism and inherited practice. Whether a placement here ends up at the table or at the lectern, the underlying gift is identical: a mystical ingenuity that arrives at answers by a route nobody else would have taken.

leo_15.title: Leo 15
leo_15.summary: Hidden brilliance recovered by long, patient labour.
leo_15.fullText: A large diamond sits embedded in a mass of black rock. Nothing about the surface advertises what is in it, and the extraction is slow — placements must work considerably harder than their gifts should require, and the recognition arrives late rather than never. Good reasoning, genuine originality and immense perseverance define the temperament, which is patient and plodding by necessity. Fearless and independent underneath, the degree combines optimism with real generosity.

leo_16.title: Leo 16
leo_16.summary: High standing achieved, and the envy that comes attached.
leo_16.fullText: A pyramid stands in waste ground. The monument is real and the surroundings are empty, which is the degree's lesson — dignity is attained here, and the native discovers that power draws envy and does not reliably produce happiness. Placements are frank and affectionate students of life who teach unusually well. The enthusiasm is forceful enough to command a room.
